maddeler.e:
أتماوت (form VI)
# أَتَمَاوَتُ (ʔatamāwatu) /ʔa.ta.maː.wa.tu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَمَاوَتَ (tamāwata)
# أَتَمَاوَتَ (ʔatamāwata) /ʔa.ta.maː.wa.ta/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَمَاوَتَ (tamāwata)
# أَتَمَاوَتْ (ʔatamāwat) /ʔa.ta.maː.wat/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَمَاوَتَ (tamāwata)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
